episodes.synopsis: Hot off the heels of their first win, the players of Nishiura High School are fired up for the rest of the summer tournament!
episodes.title: What's Next?

episodes.synopsis: Before the next match, the Nishiura Nine go to watch the game of their next opponent. There they discover Sakitama High's cleanup hitter, Daichi Sakura.
episodes.title: Sakitama

episodes.synopsis: Nishiura High's next opponent, Sakitama High, has an incredibly strong batter. If Nishiura wants any chance of winning, Nishiura will need a quick shutout win!
episodes.title: Third Match

episodes.synopsis: Hanai is the cleanup batter for Nishiura in the third match, and is struggling to get out from behind Tajima's shadow. Hanai questions whether or not he's a dependable player.
episodes.title: Baseball Is Tough

episodes.synopsis: Abe's strategy to walk Sakitama's cleanup hitter is working. While Sakitama can't score a run, their third-year Oyama dwells on the end of his baseball career.
episodes.title: I Want To Play Ball

episodes.synopsis: After one of many misunderstandings, Mihashi comes to realize that he's an important baseball player of Nishiura High.
episodes.title: Important

episodes.synopsis: Nishiura's third game against Kounan begins. Bijyou High's coaches observe the game, and conclude that Abe, the catcher is deciding all of Mihashi's pitches.
episodes.title: A Gradual Change

episodes.synopsis: The game against Bijyou Dai Sayama High has begun, and Mihashi questions why Bijyou's batters only seem to swing on pitches that are the opposite of what they like to hit.
episodes.title: Fifth Match

episodes.synopsis: It's 4-0, and Nishiura hasn't gotten a single run. After discovering that the courses were wrong and that Bijyou had scouted them, Abe is able to lead Mihashi to pitch two no-hit innings.
episodes.title: We're Being Scouted

episodes.synopsis: After scoring two runs, Bijyou High turns up the heat and sends out its reserve pitcher, Kashima. Kashima throws intense fast balls, but he's just warming up! Can Nishiura land a hit?
episodes.title: Bottom of the Fifth, 2-5

episodes.synopsis: The unthinkable has happened! Abe is injured and can no longer participate in the match. Mihashi must step up to the pitcher's mound and discover some self-confidence.
episodes.title: Because I'm the Ace

episodes.synopsis: It's the final inning and Nishiura is still behind in runs. Coming to terms with Abe's injury, Mihashi realizes that he was shoving all of his responsibilities onto Abe.
episodes.title: Ninth Inning

episodes.synopsis: Accepting their defeat against Bijyou Dai Sayama High, Mihashi and the Nishiura Nine work to come up with a team goal. Mihashi receives an ambiguous text from Abe.
episodes.title: We Begin Again
